subject: change alignment labels of vertical grid panels

messages.subject: change alignment labels of vertical grid panels
parts:
Hi there,

consider the following plot:

ggplot(diamonds)+geom_point(aes(x=carat,y=price))+facet_grid(clarity ~ cut)

is it possible to make the labels of the vertical grid labels from clarity horizontal in stead of vertical?

Cheers,

Irsan

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: change alignment labels of vertical grid panels
parts:
On Mon, Nov 5, 2012 at 9:27 AM, Irsan Kooi <irsan...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi there,
>
> consider the following plot:
>
> ggplot(diamonds)+geom_point(aes(x=carat,y=price))+facet_grid(clarity ~ cut)
>
> is it possible to make the labels of the vertical grid labels from clarity
> horizontal in stead of vertical?

Sure:

ggplot(diamonds)+geom_point(aes(x=carat,y=price))+facet_grid(clarity ~
cut) + theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle=0))

Best,
Ista
